title: Alpha-particle scattering
back: Large impact parameter: small deflection. Head-on: bounces back. So the positive charge sits in a tiny nucleus.

title: Hydrogen energy levels
back: E_n = −13.6/n² eV. Down to n = 1: Lyman (UV); to n = 2: Balmer (visible); to n = 3: Paschen (IR).

title: Distance of closest approach
legend: K = kinetic energy of the α particle
back: Upper limit on the size of the nucleus.

title: Bohr’s quantum condition
back: De Broglie: 2πr = nλ, a whole number of wavelengths round the orbit.

title: Energy of the nth orbit
back: Ionisation energy 13.6 eV; first excitation 10.2 eV.

title: Rydberg formula
back: Longest line: n_i = n_f + 1. Series limit: n_i = ∞.

title: Hydrogen series by lower level
back: "Lucknow, Bareilly, Patna, Bhopal, Pune": Lyman 1, Balmer 2, Paschen 3, Brackett 4, Pfund 5.
